awards.title: **FAST 5 Award**
awards.description: 5 DCP goals and 20 members (or +3 net growth).
awards.description2:
**Eligibility:** Clubs must meet *all three* requirements:
 • Submit the Club Success Plan (CSP) by *September 30, 2026*.
 • Achieve at least **5** Distinguished Club Program (DCP) goals by *December 31, 2026*.
 • Have at least **20 members** *OR* net membership growth of **3** by *December 31, 2026*.
 **Deadline:** December 31, 2026
 **Data source:** Toastmasters dashboard reports
 **Recognition:** Certificates and ribbons for qualifying clubs.

awards.title: **Networking Club Award**
awards.description: Joint meetings with other clubs, at Bronze, Silver and Gold levels.
awards.description2:
**Rules:**
 • Two clubs organise the meeting together.
 • Meeting roles are shared approximately *50/50*.
 • Meetings may be *in person, hybrid or online*.
 • After each meeting, submit the online reporting form, a group photograph and a link to a social media post.
 🥉 **BRONZE:** 3 joint meetings with at least 2 different clubs
 → including 1 club from outside your Area
 🥈 **SILVER:** 6 joint meetings with at least 3 different clubs
 → including 1 from outside your Area
 → and 1 from outside your Division
 🥇 **GOLD:** 9 joint meetings with at least 5 different clubs
 → including 1 from outside your Area
 → and 2 from outside your Division
 💥 **After your joint meeting:** submit the [Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfj6xjxCG-VpzgDg4JExwjRxqVlMzMedt8hfEJ4-HHZMmNAdA/viewform)
 **Recognition:** Statue awards at Bronze, Silver and Gold levels during the *District Conference*.

awards.title: **Early Renewal Champions**
awards.description: Six-month dues paid early for at least 50% of members and minimum 8.
awards.description2:
**Qualifying deadlines:** September 15, 2026; March 15, 2027
 • Pay *six-month* membership dues by the applicable deadline.
 • Renew at least **50%** of current club membership.
 • Renew a minimum of **8 members**.
 **Data source:** Toastmasters dashboard reports

awards.title: **Ultra Early Renewal Champions**
awards.description: Full-year dues paid by August 3 for at least 50% of members and minimum 8.
awards.description2:
**Deadline:** August 3, 2026
 • Pay *full-year* membership dues by the deadline.
 • Renew at least **50%** of current club membership.
 • Renew a minimum of **8 members**.
 **Data source:** Toastmasters dashboard reports

awards.title: **Check-in to Excellence Award**
awards.description: 7 officers trained in both COT rounds and CSP submitted by August 31.
awards.description2:
• Have at least **7 club officers** trained in *each* of the two Club Officer Training (COT) rounds.
 • Submit the Club Success Plan (CSP) by *August 31, 2026*.
 **Data source:** Club Officer Training records and CSP submission reports
 **Recognition:** Certificates presented during *District Conference*.

awards.title: **Distinguished Club Program (DCP) Recognition**
awards.description: Distinguished levels at 5, 7, 9 and 10 DCP goals.
awards.description2:
**Recognition levels (DCP goals):**
 • Distinguished Club: **5**
 • Select Distinguished Club: **7**
 • President's Distinguished Club: **9**
 • Smedley Distinguished Club: **10**
 *Official membership requirements also apply.* The *September 30, 2026* CSP deadline applies to District initiatives that specify it.

awards.title: **Smedley Award**
awards.description: 5 new, dual or reinstated members in August–September.
awards.description2:
**Award period:** August 1 – September 30, 2026
 **Eligibility:** Add **five** new, dual or reinstated members and submit their membership applications and dues to Toastmasters International during the qualifying period.
 **Recognition:** Special banner ribbon and a **10% discount** on the club's next Toastmasters International Store order.

awards.title: **Talk Up Toastmasters Award**
awards.description: 5 new, dual or reinstated members in February–March.
awards.description2:
**Award period:** February 1 – March 31, 2027
 **Eligibility:** Add **five** new, dual or reinstated members and submit their membership applications and dues to Toastmasters International during the qualifying period.
 **Recognition:** Special banner ribbon and a **10% discount** on the club's next Toastmasters International Store order.

awards.title: **Beat the Clock Award**
awards.description: 5 new, dual or reinstated members in May–June.
awards.description2:
**Award period:** May 1 – June 30, 2027
 **Eligibility:** Add **five** new, dual or reinstated members and submit their membership applications and dues to Toastmasters International during the qualifying period.
 **Recognition:** Special banner ribbon and a **10% discount** on the club's next Toastmasters International Store order.

awards.title: **Triple Crown Award**
awards.description: Any three educational awards in one program year.
awards.description2:
**Eligibility:** Complete any *three* qualifying educational awards during the 2026–2027 Toastmasters program year, including Pathways Levels 1–5, the Pathways Mentor Program and Distinguished Toastmaster (DTM).
 **Qualification period:** July 1, 2026 – June 30, 2027
 **Recognition:** District recognition, including during *Division Conferences* where applicable.
 *Note: Conference recognition should use a defined reporting cutoff, with arrangements for members qualifying later in the program year.*

awards.title: **Distinguished Toastmaster (DTM) Award**
awards.description2:
**Eligibility:** Complete all current Toastmasters International requirements for the DTM designation.
 **Qualification period:** Members achieving DTM status during the 2026–2027 program year.
 **Data source:** Toastmasters International educational achievement records
 **Recognition:** Official Toastmasters International DTM recognition, with additional District acknowledgement during *District Conference*.

awards.title: **Outstanding Member Award – Special Recognition**
awards.description: Exceptional contribution to a club, Area or Division.
awards.description2:
**Criteria:**
 • Outstanding leadership and service.
 • Mentoring and supporting other members.
 • Organising successful initiatives or events.
 • Strengthening collaboration between clubs.
 • Making a meaningful contribution to the Toastmasters community.
 **Selection:** Division Director, in consultation with the Area Directors
 **Recognition:** Special presentation highlighting the member's achievements and contributions.

awards.title: **Toastmaster of the Year Award**
awards.description: Top dedication, leadership and impact across District 231.
awards.description2:
**Nominations:** *Open to everyone.* Any member may nominate a deserving Toastmaster through the official nomination form, describing achievements, contributions and impact.
 **Nomination deadline:** *To be announced by the District*
 **Selection:** District Core Team members select the recipient based on nominations received.
 **Recognition:** Recipient announced and honoured during the *District Conference*.
